_comment: Every file in the core must state WHY it belongs there (framework by nature, not game-specific). A missing entry fails check-boundary.
app.js: app lifecycle: create/build/start/stop/destroy, mount/renderer injection, camera, fade, loadLevel
save.js: SaveSlot + HMAC, every game that saves
player/player.js: first-person/third-person/top-down character controller, plus swimming and crouching
player/character.js: geometry rig for characters and NPCs
rng.js: seeded RNG: determinism is a core property (net/replay/procgen)
env.js: WebGL2/secure-context/touch/reduced-motion checks every game needs before starting
version.js: VERSION/API_VERSION + deprecate: the public version contract
render/world-light.js: neutral sky/lights; the game supplies the palette
